id.description: Must equal the filename stem and appear in dialects/index.json.

family.description: A family strategy id from strategies.json.

fields.description: The dialect's fields in the order they are written in an expression.

min.description: Lowest accepted value, inclusive, in the dialect's own numbering.

max.description: Highest accepted value, inclusive, in the dialect's own numbering. Anything outside min..max is an out-of-range error.

names.description: Which set of three-letter names this field accepts, case-insensitively.

sundayIs.description: The number this dialect writes Sunday as in day-of-week. Parsed values are canonicalised from it to Sunday = 0.

tokens.description: The special tokens this field supports. A token the grammar can parse but this list omits is not an error: the term parses with unsupported: true and is still evaluated.

optional.description: This trailing field may be omitted.

macros.description: Macro name to the field string it expands to, parsed as if typed. null means a macro that carries no schedule (@reboot). Names are matched case-sensitively.

trailingCommand.description: True: tokens past the last field become Schedule.trailing (a crontab line). False: extra tokens are a field-count error.

rangeWrap.description: What a range whose start is after its end means: a bad-range error, an empty set, or wrapping across the field boundary.

singleStep.description: What a step after a single value (5/15) means: a bad-step error, or 5 through the field maximum every 15.

domDow.description: A domDow strategy id from strategies.json.

dstGap.description: A dstGap strategy id from strategies.json.

dstOverlap.description: A dstOverlap strategy id from strategies.json.

missedRuns.description: What the reference implementation does with runs missed while it was not running. Recorded for later work; the engine does not read it.

defaultTimezone.description: What the reference implementation assumes when its user names no zone. A fact about the dialect, not about this library: parse here defaults to UTC and a Schedule always carries an explicit zone.
